# LLEGIR DADES
```{r}
library(bnlearn)
data<-read.csv("ranked_10min.csv")
```


# OUTLIERS
```{r}
qblue<-quantile(data$blueWardsPlaced, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
qred<-quantile(data$redWardsPlaced, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

data2<-data[data["blueWardsPlaced"] >= qblue[1] & data["blueWardsPlaced"] <= qblue[2] & data["redWardsPlaced"] >= qred[1] & data["redWardsPlaced"] <= qred[2], ]
hist(data2$blueWardsPlaced, breaks = 90, col = "skyblue", main = "Histograma de Wards")
hist(data2$redWardsPlaced, breaks = 90, col = "pink", main = "Histograma de Wards")


quantile(data2$blueWardsPlaced, probs = c(1/5, 2/5, 3/5, 4/5))
```

# DISCRETIZAR VARIABLES CONTINUAS
```{r}

data2$blutotalgold <-abs(data2$blueTotalGold-data2$redTotalGold)

vars_cont<-c("blueWardsPlaced", "blueWardsDestroyed", "blueAssists", "blueTotalGold", "blueTotalExperience", "blueTotalMinionsKilled", "blueTotalJungleMinionsKilled", "blueKills", "blueDeaths", "redWardsPlaced", "redWardsDestroyed", "redAssists","redTotalExperience", "redTotalMinionsKilled", "redTotalJungleMinionsKilled", "redKills", "redDeaths")

vars_disc<-c("blueWins", "blueFirstBlood", "blueDragons", "blueHeralds", "redDragons", "redHeralds")

towers_destroyed<-c("blueTowersDestroyed", "redTowersDestroyed")

data_disc<-data2[vars_disc]

for (v in vars_cont) {
  nuevo_nombre <- paste0(v, "_disc")
  puntos_corte <- unique(quantile(data2[[v]], 
                                probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = 7), 
                                na.rm = TRUE))
  data_disc[[nuevo_nombre]] <- cut(data2[[v]], 
                                breaks = puntos_corte, 
                                include.lowest = TRUE, 
                                labels = FALSE)
}

# Aplicar a ambos equipos
for (v in towers_destroyed) {
  nuevo_nombre <- paste0(v, "_disc")
  data_disc[[nuevo_nombre]] <- ifelse(data2[[v]] >= 2, 2, data2[[v]])
}
```


# DIVIDIR EN TRAIN Y TEST
```{r}
data_bn <- as.data.frame(lapply(data_disc, as.factor))

n <- nrow(data_bn)
n_entrenamiento <- round(0.8 * n)
indices_entrenamiento <- sample(1:n, size = n_entrenamiento)

data_bn_train <- data_bn[indices_entrenamiento, ]
data_bn_test <- data_bn[-indices_entrenamiento, ]
```


# FEATURE SELECTION
```{r}
k <- 15 # num folds
set.seed(123)

indices <- sample(1:nrow(data_bn))
folds <- cut(indices, breaks = k, labels = FALSE)

lista_mb <- list()

for(i in 1:k) {
  datos_entrenamiento <- data_bn[folds != i, ]
  dag_temp <- hc(datos_entrenamiento)
  
  # Extraemos el Markov Blanket de la victoria en esta división
  lista_mb[[i]] <- mb(dag_temp, "blueWins")
}

# Unificamos todos los resultados en un solo vector
todas_las_variables <- unlist(lista_mb)

# Creamos una tabla de frecuencias
frecuencia_features <- table(todas_las_variables)

# Ordenamos para ver cuáles son las más estables
frecuencia_features <- sort(frecuencia_features, decreasing = TRUE)
features <- names(frecuencia_features)
print(frecuencia_features)
```

# AUGMENTED NAIVE BAYES

## Amb feature selection:
```{r}
nb_inicial_reduit <- naive.bayes(data_bn_train[c("blueWins", features)], "blueWins")
arcos_nb_reduit <- arcs(nb_inicial_reduit)
anb_reduit <- hc(data_bn_train[c("blueWins", features)], whitelist = arcos_nb_reduit)

anb_reduit_params <- bn.fit(anb_reduit, data = data_bn_train[c("blueWins", features)], method = "bayes")

graphviz.plot(anb_reduit_params,
              shape = "rectangle",
              # Definim un color neutre per a tots els nodes
              highlight = list(nodes = nodes(anb_reduit_params), 
                               fill = "aliceblue", 
                               col = "darkblue"))
library(bnlearn)
library(ggplot2)

# Convertir blueWins a factor
data_disc$blueWins <- as.factor(data_disc$blueWins)

# Si vols assegurar-te que TOTA la base de dades està en el format correcte:
data_disc <- as.data.frame(lapply(data_disc, as.factor))

# 1. Llistem els nodes que influeixen en blueWins (excloent el propi node)
nodes_a_testar <- setdiff(nodes(anb_reduit_params), "blueWins")

# 2. Calculem la Informació Mútua (MI) per a cada node
# Nota: Necessites el teu dataset de validació o entrenament (ex: data_disc)
importancia <- sapply(nodes_a_testar, function(node) {
  # Calculem el test de independència basada en MI
  ci.test(node, "blueWins", data = data_disc, test = "mi")$statistic
})

# 3. Creem un dataframe per visualitzar els resultats
df_importancia <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(importancia),
  Importancia = as.numeric(importancia)
)

# Ordenem de major a menor
df_importancia <- df_importancia[order(-df_importancia$Importancia), ]

# 4. Grafiquem els resultats
ggplot(df_importancia, aes(x = reorder(Variable, Importancia), y = Importancia)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Importància dels Nodes (Informació Mútua)",
    subtitle = "Influència directa sobre la Victòria Blava (blueWins)",
    x = "Variable",
    y = "Informació Mútua (G-test statistic)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

## codigo alt.

```{r}
# --- 0. PREPARACIÓ I LLIBRERIES ---
library(bnlearn) 
library(gRain)
library(pROC)

# anb_reduit <- hc(data_bn_train[c("blueWins", features)], whitelist = arcos_nb_reduit)

k <- 10
folds <- cut(sample(1:nrow(data_bn)), breaks = k, labels = FALSE)

# Estructures per guardar prediccions i reals
preds_prob <- list(NB_Full = c(), ANB_Full = c(), NB_MB = c(), ANB_MB = c())
reals <- c()

for(i in 1:k) {
  cat("Processant Fold", i, "de", k, "\n")
  train <- data_bn[folds != i, ]
  test <- data_bn[folds == i, ]
  reals <- c(reals, as.numeric(as.character(test$blueWins)))
  
  # Definició dels 4 models
  m1 <- naive.bayes(train, "blueWins")                       # NB Full
  m2 <- hc(train, whitelist = arcos_nb_reduit)              # TAN Full
  m3 <- naive.bayes(train[, nodes_mb], "blueWins")           # NB MB
  m4 <- hc(train[c("blueWins", features)], whitelist = arcos_nb_reduit)   # TAN MB
  
  modelos_fold <- list(NB_Full = m1, ANB_Full = m2, NB_MB = m3, ANB_MB = m4)
  
  for(m_name in names(modelos_fold)) {
    # Ajust i inferència exacta amb gRain
    fit <- bn.fit(modelos_fold[[m_name]], data = train[, nodes(modelos_fold[[m_name]])], method = "bayes")
    junction <- compile(as.grain(fit))
    
    pred_fold <- sapply(1:nrow(test), function(j) {
      # Creem l'evidència excloent la variable objectiu
      nodes_evidencia <- setdiff(nodes(modelos_fold[[m_name]]), "blueWins")
      estats_evidencia <- as.character(unlist(test[j, nodes_evidencia]))
      
      # Per evitar errors si un estat no existeix al train (rar en n=6)
      tryCatch({
        evidencia <- setEvidence(junction, nodes = nodes_evidencia, states = estats_evidencia)
        querygrain(evidencia, nodes = "blueWins")$blueWins["1"]
      }, error = function(e) return(0.5)) # Si falla, probabilitat neutra
    })
    preds_prob[[m_name]] <- c(preds_prob[[m_name]], pred_fold)
  }
}

# --- 3. CÀLCUL DE MÈTRIQUES FINALS ---

# Funció Brier Score
brier_score <- function(reals, probs) { mean((reals - probs)^2) }

# Funció F1-Score
calc_f1 <- function(reals, probs) {
  preds <- ifelse(probs > 0.5, 1, 0)
  t <- table(Factor_Pred = factor(preds, levels=c(0,1)), Factor_Real = factor(reals, levels=c(0,1)))
  precision <- t[2,2] / sum(t[2,])
  recall <- t[2,2] / sum(t[,2])
  return(2 * (precision * recall) / (precision + recall))
}

# Calculem les mètriques per a cada model
results_list <- lapply(names(preds_prob), function(m) {
  p <- preds_prob[[m]]
  acc <- mean(ifelse(p > 0.5, 1, 0) == reals)
  roc_obj <- roc(reals, p, quiet = TRUE)
  
  if(grepl("MB", m)) { d_final <- data_bn[c("blueWins", features)] } else { d_final <- data_bn }
  
  if(grepl("ANB", m)) { final_struct <- hc(d_final) } 
  else { final_struct <- naive.bayes(d_final, "blueWins") }
  
  data.frame(
    Model = m,
    Accuracy = round(acc * 100, 2),
    AUC = round(auc(roc_obj), 3),
    Brier = round(brier_score(reals, p), 3),
    F1 = round(calc_f1(reals, p), 3),
    Arcs = narcs(final_struct),
    BIC = round(BIC(final_struct, d_final), 1),
    LogLik = round(logLik(final_struct, d_final), 1)
  )
})

resum_final <- do.call(rbind, results_list)
print(resum_final)
```


```{r}
# --- 0. PREPARACIÓ I LLIBRERIES ---
library(bnlearn)
library(gRain)
library(pROC)

k <- 10
set.seed(123)
folds <- cut(sample(1:nrow(data_bn)), breaks = k, labels = FALSE)

# Estructures per a prediccions globals
preds_prob <- list(NB_Full = c(), ANB_Full = c(), NB_MB = c(), ANB_MB = c())
reals <- c()

# Estructures per a mètriques per fold (necessàries per als tests estadístics)
fold_metrics_acc <- data.frame(matrix(NA, nrow = k, ncol = 4,
                                      dimnames = list(NULL, names(preds_prob))))
fold_metrics_auc <- data.frame(matrix(NA, nrow = k, ncol = 4,
                                      dimnames = list(NULL, names(preds_prob))))
fold_metrics_brier <- data.frame(matrix(NA, nrow = k, ncol = 4,
                                        dimnames = list(NULL, names(preds_prob))))

# --- 1. BUCLE DE VALIDACIÓ CREUADA (10-FOLD CV) ---
for(i in 1:k) {
  cat("Processant Fold", i, "de", k, "\n")
  train <- data_bn[folds != i, ]
  test  <- data_bn[folds == i, ]
  reals_fold <- as.numeric(as.character(test$blueWins))
  reals <- c(reals, reals_fold)

  m1 <- naive.bayes(train, "blueWins")
  m2 <- hc(train, whitelist = arcos_nb_reduit)
  m3 <- naive.bayes(train[, nodes_mb], "blueWins")
  m4 <- hc(train[, c("blueWins", features)], whitelist = arcos_nb_reduit)

  modelos_fold <- list(NB_Full = m1, ANB_Full = m2, NB_MB = m3, ANB_MB = m4)

  for(m_name in names(modelos_fold)) {
    fit      <- bn.fit(modelos_fold[[m_name]],
                       data   = train[, nodes(modelos_fold[[m_name]])],
                       method = "bayes")
    junction <- compile(as.grain(fit))

    pred_fold <- sapply(1:nrow(test), function(j) {
      nodes_evidencia <- setdiff(nodes(modelos_fold[[m_name]]), "blueWins")
      estats_evidencia <- as.character(unlist(test[j, nodes_evidencia]))
      tryCatch({
        evidencia <- setEvidence(junction,
                                 nodes  = nodes_evidencia,
                                 states = estats_evidencia)
        querygrain(evidencia, nodes = "blueWins")$blueWins["1"]
      }, error = function(e) 0.5)
    })

    preds_prob[[m_name]] <- c(preds_prob[[m_name]], pred_fold)

    # ── Guardem mètriques per fold ──────────────────────────────────────────
    fold_metrics_acc[i, m_name] <- mean(ifelse(pred_fold > 0.5, 1, 0) == reals_fold)
    fold_metrics_auc[i, m_name] <- as.numeric(
      auc(roc(reals_fold, pred_fold, quiet = TRUE))
    )
    fold_metrics_brier[i, m_name] <- mean((pred_fold - reals_fold)^2)
  }
}

# --- 2. FUNCIONS DE MÈTRIQUES ---
brier_score <- function(reals, probs) mean((reals - probs)^2)

calc_f1 <- function(reals, probs) {
  preds <- ifelse(probs > 0.5, 1, 0)
  t <- table(Factor_Pred = factor(preds, levels = c(0,1)),
             Factor_Real  = factor(reals,  levels = c(0,1)))
  prec <- ifelse(sum(t[2,]) == 0, 0, t[2,2] / sum(t[2,]))
  rec  <- ifelse(sum(t[,2]) == 0, 0, t[2,2] / sum(t[,2]))
  if (prec + rec == 0) return(0)
  2 * prec * rec / (prec + rec)
}

# --- 3. TAULA RESUM FINAL ---
results_list <- lapply(names(preds_prob), function(m) {
  p <- preds_prob[[m]]
  if (grepl("MB", m))  d_final <- data_bn[, c("blueWins", features)] else d_final <- data_bn
  if (grepl("ANB", m)) final_struct <- hc(d_final, whitelist = arcos_nb_reduit) else
                        final_struct <- naive.bayes(d_final, "blueWins")
  data.frame(
    Model   = m,
    Accuracy = round(mean(ifelse(p > 0.5, 1, 0) == reals) * 100, 2),
    AUC      = round(as.numeric(auc(roc(reals, p, quiet = TRUE))), 3),
    Brier    = round(brier_score(reals, p), 3),
    F1       = round(calc_f1(reals, p), 3),
    Arcs     = narcs(final_struct),
    BIC      = round(BIC(final_struct, d_final), 1),
    LogLik   = round(logLik(final_struct, d_final), 1)
  )
})
resum_final <- do.call(rbind, results_list)
cat("\n--- TAULA DE RESULTATS FINALS ---\n")
print(resum_final)

# --- 4. TESTS ESTADÍSTICS ---

realitzar_tests <- function(metric_df, nom_metrica, higher_is_better = TRUE) {
  cat("\n", strrep("=", 50))
  cat("\nTESTS ESTADÍSTICS PER A:", nom_metrica)
  cat("\n", strrep("=", 50), "\n")

  # ── 1. Normalitat (Shapiro-Wilk) ──────────────────────────────────────────
  cat("\n1. Test de normalitat (Shapiro-Wilk) per cada model:\n")
  p_norm <- sapply(metric_df, function(x) shapiro.test(x)$p.value)
  print(round(p_norm, 4))
  tots_normals <- all(p_norm > 0.05)
  cat("\nDecisió:", ifelse(tots_normals,
                           "Totes normals → Paired t-test",
                           "Alguna no normal → Wilcoxon signed-rank\n"))

  # ── 2. Comparació de tots els parells (hipòtesi unilateral) ───────────────
  # H0: Model A = Model B
  # H1: Model A > Model B  (si higher_is_better)
  # H1: Model A < Model B  (si !higher_is_better, és a dir, A té menor error)
  cat("\n2. Comparació de tots els parells:\n")
  cat("   Hipòtesi: el Model 1 és millor que el Model 2\n")
  cat(sprintf("   %-20s %-20s %10s %10s  %s\n",
              "Model 1 (millor?)", "Model 2", "Mitjana 1", "Mitjana 2", "p-value (unilateral)"))
  cat("  ", strrep("-", 75), "\n")

  models  <- names(metric_df)
  parells <- combn(models, 2, simplify = FALSE)

  resultats_parells <- lapply(parells, function(par) {
    a <- par[1]; b <- par[2]
    ma <- mean(metric_df[[a]]); mb <- mean(metric_df[[b]])

    # Ordenem: el que sembla millor va primer (segons la direcció de la mètrica)
    if (higher_is_better) {
      if (mb > ma) { a <- par[2]; b <- par[1]; ma <- mean(metric_df[[a]]); mb <- mean(metric_df[[b]]) }
      alternative <- "greater"   # H1: A > B
    } else {
      if (mb < ma) { a <- par[2]; b <- par[1]; ma <- mean(metric_df[[a]]); mb <- mean(metric_df[[b]]) }
      alternative <- "less"      # H1: A < B (menor error és millor)
    }

    if (tots_normals) {
      test  <- t.test(metric_df[[a]], metric_df[[b]],
                      paired = TRUE, alternative = alternative)
      tipus <- "t-test (unilateral)"
    } else {
      test  <- wilcox.test(metric_df[[a]], metric_df[[b]],
                           paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE, alternative = alternative)
      tipus <- "Wilcoxon (unilateral)"
    }

    sig <- ifelse(test$p.value < 0.001, "***",
           ifelse(test$p.value < 0.01,  "**",
           ifelse(test$p.value < 0.05,  "*", "ns")))

    cat(sprintf("   %-20s %-20s %10.4f %10.4f  %.4f %s  [%s]\n",
                a, b, ma, mb, test$p.value, sig, tipus))

    data.frame(Model_1  = a,
               Model_2  = b,
               Mean_1   = round(ma, 4),
               Mean_2   = round(mb, 4),
               p_value  = round(test$p.value, 4),
               Sig      = sig,
               Test     = tipus,
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })

  # ── 3. Resum interpretatiu ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cat("\n3. Resum interpretatiu:\n")
  medies <- colMeans(metric_df)
  cat("   · Mitjanes per model (de millor a pitjor):\n")
  for (m in names(sort(medies, decreasing = higher_is_better))) {
    cat(sprintf("      %s: %.4f\n", m, medies[m]))
  }

  res_df <- do.call(rbind, resultats_parells)
  n_sig  <- sum(res_df$Sig != "ns")
  n_tot  <- nrow(res_df)
  cat(sprintf("\n   · %d de %d parells mostren que el Model 1 és significativament millor (p < 0.05)\n",
              n_sig, n_tot))

  if (n_sig == 0)
    cat("   → Cap model supera significativament els altres.\n")
  else if (n_sig == n_tot)
    cat("   → Hi ha un ordre clar: cada model és significativament millor que el següent.\n")
  else
    cat("   → Alguns models es diferencien significativament, d'altres no.\n")

  invisible(res_df)
}

# ── Executem els tests ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
res_acc   <- realitzar_tests(fold_metrics_acc,   "ACCURACY",    higher_is_better = TRUE)
res_auc   <- realitzar_tests(fold_metrics_auc,   "AUC",         higher_is_better = TRUE)
res_brier <- realitzar_tests(fold_metrics_brier, "BRIER SCORE", higher_is_better = FALSE)
```
